summary: 001 proves a bounded and Proposal-ready Delivery-operation execution seam: a closed five-value DeliveryOperationId, deterministic content-bound Delivery Guidance, a minimal DeliveryOperationPackage over already-decided operation context/authority, and the first Delivery Start concrete facts/HOW. The package reliably delivers exact WHAT + exact HOW to the Agent but does not discover, choose, route, authorize, or advance Delivery operations. Exact start continuity reconstructs successfully; 178/178 domain tests and 17/17 canonical OpenSpec specs pass with no scope drift.
